metadata.description: Gatewise: Claude skills for payment gateways.

plugins.name: gatewise
plugins.description: All Gatewise payment gateway skills: PayHere, OnePay, WebXPay, Genie Business and Koko (Sri Lanka), a router that picks one, and shared payment-basics and payment-security-review.

plugins.name: gatewise-router
plugins.description: Router: picks the right Sri Lankan gateway skill from the user's region, features and stack.

plugins.name: payment-basics
plugins.description: Gateway-agnostic payment rules: idempotency, callback verification, reconciliation, PCI scope and secrets.

plugins.name: payment-security-review
plugins.description: Evidence-based security review of payment integrations: forged callbacks, amount tampering, secret leaks, IDOR, refund abuse.

plugins.name: payhere
plugins.description: PayHere (Sri Lanka): checkout, recurring, preapproval, refunds, SDKs, plugins, plans and troubleshooting.

plugins.name: onepay
plugins.description: OnePay (Sri Lanka): redirect checkout, JS SDK, payment links, card on file, refunds, payouts, plugins.

plugins.name: webxpay
plugins.description: WebXPay (Sri Lanka): RSA-encrypted checkout, Token V2 saved cards and MIT, gateway IDs, plugins, error codes.

plugins.name: koko
plugins.description: Koko (Sri Lanka BNPL): RSA-signed orderCreate, signed callback verification, Order View API, troubleshooting.

plugins.name: genie
plugins.description: Genie Business / Dialog Pay Business (Sri Lanka): hosted checkout, webhooks and signatures, card on file, MIT recurring, refunds, plugins.
